chunks: We have sent it down as a clear discourse that you may understand.
ai.seo_question: Why was the Quran revealed in Arabic?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine wisdom of using the vernacular to ensure the Quran is accessible for deep contemplation (ta'ammul) rather than mere recitation. It establishes the Arabic language as the primary vessel for conveying the intricate legal and spiritual nuances essential for the guidance of the Ahl al-Bayt and the broader community.
